summary.plain: The small team that used COSME, a compact germanium crystal in the Canfranc underground laboratory, to search for dark matter particles and solar axions.
summary.technical: 'The COSME Collaboration' (arXiv:hep-ex/0101037): University of Zaragoza (Laboratory of Nuclear and High Energy Physics), University of South Carolina and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory. The detector was built by Princeton Gamma-Tech with a PNNL cryostat.
